title: Vegon!
description: New plant-based and vegan food for Minecraft. BETA 0.0.0.2
body:
# Vegon!
Behold the **Vegon!**, a simple beta mod that adds a few (yet) new food items and related objects to Minecraft. This mod is in early development and will be updated frequently!

### Key Features:
- **New Items and Foods**: Tomato, Cucumber, Corn, Boiled Corn, Corn Shuck, Popcorn, Bunch of Popcorn, Bunch of Bamboo, Fried Bamboo, Bunch of Fried Bamboo and other items (the list will be expanded many times)_.
- **World Generation**: Nothing from this mod can be found naturally in the world _(it will be added in the next updates)_.
- **Crafting**: There are a few crafting recipes available. All other items are only accessible in Creative mode.
